facts.title: corrective action following learning team review at B-8202

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control HOT_SURFACE_GUARDING: the insulation, guarding and signing of hot surfaces was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems on B-8202, D-8210 and TT-8202 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in operating hot and steam systems, specifically preventing water ingress to hot material. B-8202 (package boilers and deaerator) is in service for process steam generation and feedwater deaeration. The task proceeded during commissioning of replacement equipment while the insulation, guarding and signing of hot surfaces was in place but did not perform. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 15 July 2024 a corrective action on B-8202, D-8210 and TT-8202 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station was reviewed against the material unwanted event control it was raised to restore.
